episodes.synopsis: Touka Scott doesn't care much about the devils supposedly ravaging the world... until a visit from the legendary hero changes everything.
episodes.title: The Legendary Hero Is Dead?!

episodes.synopsis: The new hero's party heads out on a devil-hunting quest, but questions arise about new companion Kyle's motivations.
episodes.title: The Legendary Hero Impostor

episodes.synopsis: Touka might have thought that his situation couldn't get any worse now that he's a zombie, but he was wrong.
episodes.title: The Legendary Hero Is a Skeleton!

episodes.synopsis: Touka tries to keep up his masquerade around the princess, while a sinister plot moves into motion beneath the capital.
episodes.title: The Legendary Hero and Bride

episodes.synopsis: Touka and his makeshift party tackle the true terror haunting the capital.
episodes.title: The Legendary Hero Is Revived

episodes.synopsis: A strange spell turning the townspeople into monsters forces some hard decisions from the hero's party.
episodes.title: The Legendary Hero Is a Girl

episodes.synopsis: As Touka and his friends pursue the entity enslaving the townspeople, an encounter with another adventurers' party raises new questions.
episodes.title: A New Legendary Hero

episodes.synopsis: The wicked necromancers hire a deadly mercenary to slow the party down, as new revelations arise about Touka's past.
episodes.title: The Legendary Hero Is a Student!

episodes.synopsis: Touka awakens in a familiar place—Is it the past? Is it a dream? Whatever it is, he’ll need to solve the mystery before time runs out for him and Yuna!
episodes.title: Into the Legendary Hero's Past

episodes.synopsis: The legendary hero's party finally reaches Elvania, while the king makes his own plans to stop the necromancers' plot.
episodes.title: The Raid of the Legendary Hero

episodes.synopsis: It's all coming down to the big climactic battle. Can Touka defeat Diego and save Yuna before time runs out?!
episodes.title: The Legendary Hero Fights to the Death!

episodes.synopsis: The situation is dire Touka still won't wake up, even as time ticks down. Will the day be saved, or will the legendary hero end up dead—again?
episodes.title: The Legendary Hero Is a Duo!
